; TrustIr text format v1
; E5 SLICES (crystal decision memo section 23). NOT a compiler-emitted module.
; The six slice functions are VERBATIM instruction lines of the m0off callee sidecar
; (trust seal-m0 rev 7781c8b800; callees text sha256 d3884376b2a47078014dfd604ef376f9354a6ba668729c20b1e6bb4d91fc61c5),
; each wrapped in a header naming its free operands and a `ret`, then put in trust-ir's own
; canonical form (`trust_ir::format::canonical`: dense SSA renumbering, nothing else):
;   e5::get_const_d14          <- clean_kernel::env::Environment::get_const, lines 18338-18355 (%29..%46)
;   e5::get_const_vtable_read  <- the same body, lines 18338-18345 (%29..%36): D14's vtable read
;   e5::get_const_rebuild      <- the same body, lines 18354-18355 (%45..%46): the trait-object rebuild
;   e5::name_eq_arc_str_deref  <- <clean_kernel::name::Name as PartialEq>::eq, lines 31140-31147 (%107..%114)
;   e5::name_eq_ptr_eq         <- <clean_kernel::name::Name as PartialEq>::eq, lines 31073-31074, 31078-31080
;   e5::nameinner_clone_data   <- <clean_kernel::name::NameInner as Clone>::clone, lines 27906-27911 (%69..%74)
; The struct rows are the dump's own (ids 4, 6, 53, 54, 77, 78, 90, 91). The e5::drive_* functions,
; the e5_* globals and e5::control_thin_icmp are SYNTHETIC: drivers for trust-ir's reference
; interpreter that build a buffer of markers (0x1000 + byte offset) and vtables
; [drop = 0, size = 24, align], call one slice, and observe what it returns. Their EvalIR twins
; are kernel runs over the minted slices (tests/eval_ir/e5_fat_images.rs).
; e5_m0off_slices.trust-ir.bin beside this file is its binary encoding (serialize_module of the
; parsed text), which the projector reads; the projector's test holds the two equal through
; trust_ir::format::canonical, comment lines aside.
module "e5_m0off_slices"
